summary: # Event Library Reference Comprehensive list of events to track by business type and context. ## Contents - Marketing Site Events (navigation & engagement, CTA & form interactions, conversion events) - Product/App Events (onboarding, core usage, errors & support) - Monetization Events (pricing & checkout, subscription management) - E-commerce Events (browsing, cart, checkout, post-purchase) - B2B / SaaS Specific Events (team & collaboration, integration events, account events) - Event Properties (Parameters) - Funnel Event Sequences
